00109 SERVER_ERROR CServer::AddEnterAccount( UINT nLoginId, UINT nSelCharId, const char * pszAccount )

00121         pEnterInfo->nSelCharId = nSelCharId;
00122         pEnterInfo->dwEnterTime = timeGetTime();

00128 BOOL CServer::GetEnterInfo( UINT nLoginId, UINT nSelCharId, const char * pszAccount, ENTERGAMESERVER & enterinfo )
